name: front-raise-cable
title: Front Raise: Cable
primer: An exercise for shoulders, chest, and forearm strengthening.
steps: Place the pulley on the setting just above the floor.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your knees slightly bent.
Starting at waist height, take the pulley in your left hand, palm facing the floor (an overhand grip), and raise your straight arm up towards your left shoulder.
At shoulder height pause for a moment.
With a controlled movement resist the weight and slowly lower your arm back to the starting position at your waist.
Repeat the exercise with your right arm.
tips: Maintain a good posture at all times during this exercise, without swaying or arching your back.
Do not perform this exercise if you have shoulder pain.
